topic: Tracing and identification of various under carriage components, Shock observers, types, brief description and operation
syllabus_extract: Tracing and identification of various under carriage components, Shock observers, types, brief description and operation
specific_objectives: 23.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe typical alighting gears of an aircraft and its construction.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of under carriage components and shock absorber types on aircraft training equipment; Safety: Ensure training equipment stability and no loose parts; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee handling of components.
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of the aircraft landing gear?
Name the three main types of landing gear configurations.
Define the term 'shock absorber' in the context of landing gear.

development.content:
Landing gear assembly overview
Main and nose gear identification
Wheel well and strut components
Hydraulic lines and actuators
Brake assembly location

Shock absorber types overview
Oil-air shock absorber operation
Nylon cord shock absorber operation
Mechanical spring shock absorber
Telescopic strut construction

Shock absorber maintenance basics
Common failure modes identification
Operational checks and testing
Component replacement procedures
Safety precautions during inspection

summary_questions: Explain the difference between oil-air and nylon cord shock absorbers.
Describe the construction of a typical telescopic strut.
List the key components found in the main landing gear assembly.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between main wheel and nose wheel configurations for the next lesson (LP 16).
